name: @oresoftware/linked-queue
description: Synchronous queue implementation with constant/linear time operations.

scripts.build: tsc && node scripts/write-package-boundaries.cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && node scripts/write-package-boundaries.cjs
scripts.test:internal:standalone: node test/internal/linked-list-integrity.js && node test/internal/head-tail-fuzz.js && node test/internal/lookup-consistency.js
scripts.test:legacy: node test/src/test-fuzz.js && node test/src/linked-queue-fuzz.js && node test/src/queue-fuzz.js && node test/src/basic-queue-fuzz.js
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:internal:standalone && npm run test:legacy
scripts.lint:ores: if [ -f .ores-lint/lint.sh ]; then sh .ores-lint/lint.sh; else echo 'ores-lint not installed'; fi

author: Olegzandr VD
